fact: The plan, drawing on the WMO 2020 country profile, records that only 3 of 14 synoptic stations of the Direction générale de la météorologie are operational, that no multi-hazard early warning division exists, that impact-based forecast and warning services exist within the national service but are weak, and that no multi-hazard early warning system is in place.
title: Plan national initial d'adaptation aux changements climatiques de la République centrafricaine
publisher: Ministère de l'Environnement et du Développement Durable, République centrafricaine
